reasons: The cited clause is a no-hire ('agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party') that binds us as Customer and, in its first limb, reaches all of the other party's employees with no nexus to the engagement and no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out — squarely walk-away territory under NOSOLICIT, so 'deviation' is correctly classified rather than an acceptable fallback.

The redline reaches the fallback precisely: mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months measured from the end of that involvement, express carve-outs for general advertisements/non-targeted recruitment and self-initiated approaches, and deletion of the no-hire (with a clarifying sentence that hiring is not prohibited).

The failed 'minimal edit' heuristic (0.753 changed-character ratio) is justified here: converting a no-hire into a narrowed non-solicit and adding the required carve-out sentence cannot be done without rewriting the clause; no extraneous terms were introduced.
The comment is accurate, in the required voice and prefix, states what changed and why, and cites the playbook position without lecturing.
